commitments.label: Avoid meat for one meal
commitments.value: Avoid meat for one meal during the agreed action window.

commitments.label: Donate a fixed amount
commitments.value: Donate the stated fixed amount to the agreed organization by the agreed date.
commitments.description: A bounded donation with recipient, amount, and deadline recorded.

commitments.label: Redirect a planned donation
commitments.value: Redirect the stated planned donation to the agreed destination if the trade is confirmed.
commitments.description: Changes the destination of money already planned for donation.

commitments.label: Volunteer a fixed number of hours
commitments.value: Volunteer the stated number of hours for the agreed organization or project by the agreed date.

commitments.label: Complete one defined task
commitments.value: Complete the agreed task by the agreed deadline and provide the agreed evidence.
commitments.description: A single deliverable with an observable finish.

commitments.label: Publish a public statement
commitments.value: Publish the agreed public statement and keep it available for the stated duration.

commitments.label: Change a recurring behavior
commitments.value: Follow the agreed behavior for the stated duration, subject to the agreed safety and exit terms.
commitments.description: A repeated action with a clear duration and exit rule.

templates.label: Research {topic} for fixed hours
templates.value: Research {topic} for the agreed fixed number of hours, keep a dated work log, and stop when the agreed time limit is reached.
templates.description: A time-bounded research commitment with the topic and hours recorded.

templates.label: Complete a defined {topic} research deliverable
templates.value: Complete the agreed {topic} research deliverable by the agreed deadline, with its scope and acceptance criteria recorded in advance.
templates.description: A scoped research project with a concrete deliverable.

templates.label: Complete a {topic} literature review
templates.value: Review the agreed body of literature on {topic} and deliver a cited summary by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A bounded literature review with a cited output.

templates.label: Publish a {topic} research output
templates.value: Publish the agreed research output on {topic} by the agreed deadline and provide a stable link or file.
templates.description: A public or shareable research output with a durable record.

templates.label: Write a defined {topic} document
templates.value: Write the agreed {topic} document within the recorded length, scope, and deadline.
templates.description: A bounded writing task with a defined format and scope.

templates.label: Publish a {topic} article or brief
templates.value: Publish the agreed article or brief about {topic} by the agreed deadline and provide a stable link or file.
templates.description: A publication commitment with a durable output.

templates.label: Edit a {topic} draft to agreed criteria
templates.value: Edit the agreed {topic} draft to the recorded acceptance criteria by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A defined editing task with reviewable completion criteria.

templates.label: Build a defined {topic} prototype
templates.value: Build the agreed {topic} prototype to the recorded scope and acceptance criteria by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A bounded prototype with an observable finish.

templates.label: Ship an agreed {topic} feature
templates.value: Implement and deliver the agreed {topic} feature by the agreed deadline, subject to the recorded tests and acceptance criteria.
templates.description: A scoped implementation commitment with explicit tests.

templates.label: Complete a bounded {topic} technical task
templates.value: Complete the agreed bounded technical task for {topic} and provide the agreed completion evidence.
templates.description: A technical task limited by the recorded scope.

templates.label: Volunteer fixed hours for {topic}
templates.value: Volunteer the agreed fixed number of hours for {topic} by the agreed date and provide the agreed activity record.
templates.description: A time-capped volunteer commitment.

templates.label: Complete a defined {topic} volunteer shift
templates.value: Complete the agreed volunteer shift for {topic}, limited to the recorded role, location, and duration.
templates.description: A specific volunteer shift with a bounded role.

templates.label: Teach a fixed {topic} session
templates.value: Teach the agreed {topic} session for the recorded duration and audience by the agreed date.
templates.description: A single, time-bounded teaching commitment.

templates.label: Prepare and deliver a {topic} lesson
templates.value: Prepare and deliver the agreed lesson on {topic}, including the recorded materials and completion criteria.
templates.description: A lesson with defined preparation and delivery.

templates.label: Contact an agreed number of people about {topic}
templates.value: Contact the agreed number and type of recipients about {topic} using the recorded lawful, non-harassing message and deadline.
templates.description: Bounded outreach with a recipient count and safety constraints.

templates.label: Run a bounded {topic} outreach project
templates.value: Run the agreed outreach project about {topic}, limited by the recorded audience, channels, duration, and no-harassment terms.
templates.description: A scoped outreach project with explicit boundaries.

templates.label: Translate a defined {topic} document
templates.value: Translate the agreed {topic} document between the recorded languages by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A bounded translation with named source and target languages.

templates.label: Review a {topic} translation
templates.value: Review the agreed {topic} translation against the recorded accuracy and style criteria by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A translation review with explicit acceptance criteria.

templates.label: Donate a fixed amount to {topic}
templates.value: Donate the agreed fixed amount to the recorded {topic} recipient by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A fixed donation with recipient, amount, and deadline recorded.

templates.label: Redirect a planned donation to {topic}
templates.value: Redirect the recorded planned donation to the agreed {topic} recipient if the trade is confirmed.
templates.description: Changes the destination of an already-planned donation.

templates.label: Complete a defined learning module about {topic}
templates.value: Complete the agreed learning module about {topic} by the agreed deadline and provide the recorded completion evidence.
templates.description: A bounded learning commitment with an identifiable endpoint.

templates.label: Read and summarize an agreed work about {topic}
templates.value: Read the agreed work about {topic} and deliver the recorded summary by the agreed deadline.
templates.description: A reading commitment paired with a concrete summary.

evidence.label: Redacted donation receipt
evidence.value: A redacted receipt showing the recipient, amount, and date, with payment identifiers and unrelated personal information removed.

evidence.label: Time-stamped photo or activity log
evidence.value: A time-stamped photo or activity log covering the agreed action window, with private location and identity details removed.
evidence.description: Useful for a physical action when a receipt does not exist.

evidence.label: Participant attestation
evidence.value: A dated participant attestation that the commitment was completed, subject to challenge under the agreed review process.
evidence.description: Low-burden evidence for a small, low-stakes commitment.

evidence.label: Counterparty confirmation
evidence.value: The counterparty confirms completion after reviewing the agreed completion record.
evidence.description: Useful when the counterparty can directly observe completion.

evidence.label: Independent witness confirmation
evidence.value: A named independent witness confirms the specific observable fact required by the agreement.
evidence.description: Adds corroboration without exposing unnecessary personal data.

evidence.label: Public link or external record
evidence.value: A stable public link or external record showing the agreed deliverable, publication, or transaction.
evidence.description: Best for work that already has a durable online record.

durations.label: One meal
durations.description: One clearly identified meal or equivalent action window.

durations.label: One day
durations.description: A single calendar day in the participant's local time.

baselines.label: Both sides continue their current plans
baselines.value: Without this trade, both participants continue their current plans and neither added commitment occurs.
baselines.description: Use when neither commitment is already planned.

baselines.label: One donation is already planned
baselines.value: Without this trade, the stated donation still occurs but goes to its original planned destination; the reciprocal commitment does not occur.
baselines.description: Use for donation redirection rather than new donation.

baselines.label: One action is already planned
baselines.value: Without this trade, the already-planned action still occurs; only the additional reciprocal commitment is counterfactual.

baselines.label: Current behavior continues
baselines.value: Without this trade, each participant continues the behavior they currently expect to follow during the action window.

exits.label: Withdraw before final confirmation
exits.value: Either participant may withdraw before both participants confirm the final terms; no commitment begins before that confirmation.
exits.description: The default for a proposal that has not yet been locked.

exits.label: End future obligations with notice
exits.value: Either participant may end future obligations by notifying the other participant; completed periods remain recorded.
exits.description: Stops future performance without rewriting completed history.

exits.label: Pause for safety or health
exits.value: Either participant may pause immediately for a documented safety or health concern, with future terms reviewed before performance resumes.
exits.description: A fail-safe for commitments that could become unsafe.

exits.label: End if the counterparty materially breaches
exits.value: A material missed commitment, after the agreed notice and review window, releases the other participant from future obligations.
exits.description: A reciprocal remedy for material non-performance.
